GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.

7. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.

10. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Polymers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Electrolysis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Electrostatics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Motion 3.5 Electromagnetic Spectrum Page 12 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
